import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,time
root=pathlib.Path('research/r31v_postidle/evidence/ncp_host')
tag=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
out=root/(tag+'_r31v')
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
base=pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')
group=pathlib.Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::',1)[1]
leaf=base/group.lstrip('/')
ancestors=[]; p=leaf
while True:
 row={'path':str(p)}
 for name in ('cpu.max','cpu.stat','memory.current','memory.max','memory.swap.current','memory.swap.max','memory.events','cpuset.cpus.effective','cgroup.procs'):
  f=p/name
  row[name]=f.read_text().strip() if f.is_file() else None
 ancestors.append(row)
 if p==base:break
 p=p.parent
processes=[]
for d in pathlib.Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not d.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  cmd=(d/'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\0',b' ').decode(errors='replace').strip()
  if not cmd:continue
  status={k:v.strip() for k,v in (line.split(':',1) for line in (d/'status').read_text().splitlines() if ':' in line)}
  processes.append({'pid':int(d.name),'ppid':int(status['PPid']),'threads':int(status['Threads']),'state':status['State'],'cmdline':cmd,'cgroup':(d/'cgroup').read_text().strip(),'affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(int(d.name)))})
 except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError,PermissionError,ValueError):continue
mem={}
for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines():
 if line.startswith(('MemTotal:','MemAvailable:','SwapTotal:','SwapFree:')):mem[line.split(':')[0]]=line.split(':')[1].strip()
result={'schema':'WU088_R31V_NCP_LIVE_INVENTORY_V1','captured_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'boot_id':pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),'mountinfo_cgroup2':[line for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines() if ' - cgroup2 ' in line],'self_cgroup':group,'self_affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'ancestors':ancestors,'meminfo':mem,'processes':sorted(processes,key=lambda x:x['pid']),'scope':'READ_ONLY_INSTANTANEOUS_CENSUS__FUTURE_EXCLUSIVITY_NOT_PROVEN'}
p=out/'HOST_INVENTORY.json';b=(json.dumps(result,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode();p.write_bytes(b)
(out/'HOST_INVENTORY.sha256').write_text(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()+'  HOST_INVENTORY.json\n')
print(out,hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),len(processes),'processes')
